data.financial_boundary: The prior freeze is lifted by user authorization. Development and campaign provisions are reconciled against existing funded capacity; recurring delivery and support remain unit costs.

pending_investment_costs.basis: 6 QA equivalents × 10 months × $3,000 loaded monthly allowance
3 technical writers × 8 months × $2,500 loaded monthly allowance

campaign_costs.basis: 6 pilots × $5,000 deployment/demo allowance; no sales conversion assumed
3 months × $25,000; no leads or sales uplift assumed

totals.incremental_investment_to_book_usd: Calculated in the linked reconciliations, not gross budget added twice.

data.assumptions: All staffing, hours, prices and campaign allowances are explicit alternative-history planning assumptions, not supplier quotes or historical facts.

financial_integration.development_treatment: Gross budget less allocated existing payroll; remainder expensed in industrial ledger.
financial_integration.contingency: Full budget provision included as conservative planned expense; not a claim of realized spending.
financial_integration.launch_price: Explicit $745.23 launch and 1982 adoption price: 50% of frozen $1490.45 prior June-1982/November-launch proxy. Delivery costs unchanged; unit loss is disclosed; existing demand and ROI outputs predate this policy.

adoption_pricing.reference_basis: Pre-change June 15 1982 Team Edition retail, previously used as the explicit November 1981 launch-price proxy. Not a historical market quotation.
adoption_pricing.scope: Launch and subsequent modelled snapshots through 1982; no change to June 1981 prelaunch availability. No automatic expiry or second compounded reduction.
adoption_pricing.rationale: User-authorized rapid-adoption price; explicit exception to balanced pricing and the cost floor. Preserve one server/four concurrent users, 20h onboarding, 12h first-year support, media and documentation. Hardware remains separate.
adoption_pricing.loss_treatment: Show actual negative unit contribution after dealer fees. Do not add the same shortfall a second time as a marketing expense in a future P&L. Forecast quantities and aggregate subsidy exposure require a separate demand review.
adoption_pricing.launch_cost_basis: Use the first costed June 1982 delivery snapshot as a disclosed proxy for November 1981; no fabricated November cost study.
